verses.text: A Psalm of David, in his fleeing from the face of Absalom his son. O YHWH, how many are my adversaries! Many [are] rising up against me!

segments.text: A Psalm of David, in his fleeing from the face of Absalom his son. O YHWH, how many are my adversaries! Many [are] rising up against me!

verses.text: Many are saying of my soul, “There is no salvation for him in God.” Selah

segments.text: Many are saying of my soul, “There is no salvation for him in God.” Selah

verses.text: and You, O YHWH, are a shield behind me, my glory, and One lifting high my head.

segments.text: and You, O YHWH, are a shield behind me, my glory, and One lifting high my head.

verses.text: With my voice I cry to YHWH, and He answers me from the mountain of His holiness. Selah

segments.text: With my voice I cry to YHWH, and He answers me from the mountain of His holiness. Selah

verses.text: I lie down and sleep; I awake, for YHWH sustains me.

segments.text: I lie down and sleep; I awake, for YHWH sustains me.

verses.text: I shall not fear the multitudes of people, who have set [themselves] all around against me.

segments.text: I shall not fear the multitudes of people, who have set [themselves] all around against me.

verses.text: Arise, O YHWH! Save me, O my God! O that You would strike all my enemies [on] the jaw; may you break the teeth of the wicked!

segments.text: Arise, O YHWH! Save me, O my God! O that You would strike all my enemies [on] the jaw; may you break the teeth of the wicked!

verses.text: Unto YHWH [is] the salvation; may Your blessing [be] upon Your people. Selah

segments.text: Unto YHWH [is] the salvation; may Your blessing [be] upon Your people. Selah
